#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
using LL = long long;
const int MAXN = 510;
int n, m, p;
LL c[MAXN][MAXN], f[MAXN], g[MAXN], dp[MAXN][MAXN][MAXN], ways[MAXN][MAXN][MAXN];

void add_mod(LL &x, LL y) {
    x = (x + y) % p;
}

LL cal(LL x) {
    return (x * (x - 1) / 2) % p;
}

int main() {
    cin >> n >> m >> p;
    for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; ++i) c[i][0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i < MAXN; ++i) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= i; ++j) {
            c[i][j] = (c[i - 1][j - 1] + c[i - 1][j]) % p;
        }
    }
    fill(f, f + MAXN, 0);
    fill(g, g + MAXN, 0);
    f[0] = 0; g[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; ++i) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= i; ++j) {
            LL add1 = c[i - 1][j - 1] * f[j - 1] % p * g[i - j] % p * (i + 1) % p;
            LL add2 = c[i - 1][j - 1] * g[j - 1] % p * f[i - j] % p * (i + 1) % p;
            add_mod(f[i], add1 + add2 + (c[i - 1][j - 1] * g[j - 1] % p * g[i - j] % p) * ((cal(j) + cal(i - j + 1)) % p) % p);
            add_mod(g[i], c[i - 1][j - 1] * g[j - 1] % p * g[i - j] % p * (i + 1) % p);
        }
    }
    memset(dp, 0, sizeof(dp));
    memset(ways, 0, sizeof(ways));
    dp[0][0][0] = 0; ways[0][0][0] = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i <= n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= min(i, m); ++j) {
            for (int k = 0; k <= min(j, m); ++k) {
                add_mod(dp[i + 1][j][0], dp[i][j][k]);
                add_mod(ways[i + 1][j][0], ways[i][j][k]);
                int rem = m - (j - k);
                add_mod(ways[i + 1][j + 1][k + 1], ways[i - k][j - k][0] * c[rem][k + 1] % p * g[k + 1] % p);
                add_mod(dp[i + 1][j + 1][k + 1], dp[i - k][j - k][0] * c[rem][k + 1] % p * g[k + 1] % p + ways[i - k][j - k][0] * c[rem][k + 1] % p * f[k + 1] % p);
            }
        }
    }
    LL answer = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i <= m; ++i) {
        add_mod(answer, dp[n][m][i]);
    }
    cout << answer << endl;
}
